text: The world despairs, for [[b]]Archaon the Everchosen[[/b]], Champion of Chaos, has come – and with him, the [[b]]End Times[[/b]]!\\nIn service to the Chaos Gods, Archaon has devoted himself wholly to the world’s destruction and risen to dominance as the Everchosen – the vessel through which the Dark Gods unite their followers and turn the world into a Realm of Chaos.\\n\\nIs there any Champion of the Old World mighty enough to withstand this Lord of the End Times?
All Chaos-aligned factions have [[b]]united under Archaon[[/b]], their old territory lies in ruin and their Legendary Lords have joined the invasion
Archaon's force is [[b]]impossibly strong[[/b]] at the start of the invasion, possessing [[b]]100%[[/b]] Ward Save\\nYou [[b]]MUST[[/b]] weaken him before you have any hope of defeating him in battle
The Chaos Invasion
Regions [[b]]razed[[/b]] during this Endgame will [[b]]not[[/b]] be able to be occupied again until Archaon is utterly defeated – the world now makes its last stand against Chaos
Each Invasion force defeated anywhere in the world will [[b]]reduce Archaon's Ward Save[[/b]] by [[b]]1%[[/b]]\\nWhile strong, Invasion forces will always be destroyed after their first defeat
Provinces in which half or more of the regions have been razed will become [[b]]Devastated[[/b]]\\nDevastation causes large penalties to adjacent provinces
There are [[b]]5 Dark Fortresses[[/b]] accompanying the Invasion, each located somewhere in the world, destroying these Fortresses will reduce Archaon's Ward Save by [[b]]10%[[/b]] each
All factions fighting against the Chaos Invasion [[b]]receive large diplomatic bonuses[[/b]] with each other while the Endgame is ongoing
You must defeat Archaon's force to [[b]]achieve Victory[[/b]]. When first defeated in battle, however, Archaon is likely to make a defiant last stand

Life itself is at grave risk – for [[b]]Nagash[[/b]] has returned and begins his [[b]]Great Ritual[[/b]]!\\nA ritual to drain the life from the world itself, leaving an Undead Wasteland completely subservient to the Great Necromancer. As his Black Pyramid rises into the skies, swollen with the Winds of Shyish, its destination is clear and its path cannot be interrupted. The final battle for the fate of the world will take place at the fortress city of Nagashizzar.\\n\\nThe world teeters on the precipice of eternal darkness – is there any champion capable of defeating one who has overcome death itself?
Nagash and his Mortarchs lead his Undead Legions across the whole world, Undead factions loyal to Nagash have also become vassalised

The Black Pyramid of Nagash travels towards Nagashizzar each turn in preparation for the Great Ritual of Nagash, once it arrives the Great Ritual will begin and a final battle will be unlocked, victory in this battle is the only way to defeat the Endgame
Great Ritual of Nagash
Provinces in which half or more of the regions have been captured by Nagash will be Devastated - Devastating a province will spawn a force for the Undead Legions
Once the Great Ritual begins Nagash's power level cannot be changed, it is crucial to reduce his power level as much has possible before the final battle
Nagash's armies are empowered during the Endgame, the strength of their bonuses is tied to the number of active Mortarchs, armies and Devastated provinces
While the Great Ritual is underway provinces will be claimed by Nagash each turn - every active Mortarch will increase the number of provinces claimed
All factions fighting against Nagash's Undead Legions receive large diplomatic bonuses with each other during the Endgame
⁠The Black Pyramid of Nagash and Nagashizzar cannot be attacked during the Endgame

Mortals recoil in terror and disgust, for the Skaven clans have coalesced beneath the gaze of [[b]]Lord Skreech Verminking[[/b]] who proclaims himself leader of the [[b]]Vermintide[[/b]]!\\nHe is the herald of the Great Horned Rat in the mortal realm; an instrument manifested of the ratmen's ultimate destiny to devour the surface world, and leave nought but ruin and decay in their wake.\\n\\nOne dire question remains – can any Champion of the Old World truly stem a [[i]]tide[[/i]]?
All Skaven factions have [[b]]united under Skreech Verminking[[/b]]. Every Skaven Legendary Lord and their territory has joined the Vermintide – the Great Ascendancy is here!
It is [[b]]critical[[/b]] to defeat Vermintide armies, with each defeated army providing a chance to [[b]]learn more about their plans[[/b]] and receive items that can help overcome the Endgame.
The Vermintide
Vermintide settlements are always visible, acting as access points to the Under-Empire. Armies will continuously spawn nearby and the larger the settlement, the more armies it can spawn.
Focus on recapturing settlements occupied by the Vermintide quickly to [[b]]limit their ability to spawn armies[[/b]] and destroy Under-Cities as soon as possible to [[b]]slow their spread[[/b]].

Vermintide [[b]]Under-Cities[[/b]] are always visible and [[b]]spread rapidly[[/b]]. The longer one is allowed to exist, the more it will [[b]]sap the wealth[[/b]] of the settlement above – you must act quickly!
You have [[b]]gained access to new buildings[[/b]] that can help combat the Under-Empire, and razing settlements can help by blocking the Under-Empire's spread.
All factions fighting against the Vermintide [[b]]receive large diplomatic bonuses[[/b]] with each other while the Endgame is ongoing.
Collect enough [[b]]War Plan Knowledge[[/b]] to learn of the Vermintide's final plans, allowing you to face Skreech Verminking in a final battle to [[b]]achieve Victory[[/b]].
